text:
"TCSA" is probably a typo for TCS (Tata Consultancy Services). If you meant something else by "TCSA", it isn't in my material.

What TCS is:
India's largest IT services firm [Research].
It does IT services and consulting in 56 countries, with about 580,000 staff [AR FY26].
Its work covers AI, cloud, applications, engineering and cybersecurity [AR FY26].

Biggest verticals: banking, financial services and insurance 38.7%, communication/media/tech 15.9%, consumer 14.8% [AR FY26].
Biggest regions: North America 48.6%, UK 17.4%, Continental Europe 15.4% [AR FY26].

Scale: FY26 revenue was ₹267,021cr and PAT (net profit) was ₹49,454cr. Market cap is ₹9.12 lakh cr [Numbers].
Its stated aim is to become the world's largest AI-led technology services company [AR FY26].
AI revenue is running at $3.1B a year, over 10% of revenue [Q2FY27 call].
